title: Look, Ye Saints, the Sight Is Glorious
description: Look, Ye Saints, the Sight Is Glorious in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Kelly, first published in 1809. The tune, BRYN CALFARIA, is by William Owen (1852). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Look, ye saints; the sight is glo-rious: see the Man of_ Sor-rows now; From the fight re-turned vic-to-rious, E-very knee to_ Him shall bow: Crown__ Him! Crown__ Him! Crown__ Him!_ Crowns_ be-come_ the Vic_-tor's_ brow. Crowns be-come the_ Vic-tor's brow.

lines: Look, ye saints; the sight is glorious:
see the Man of Sorrows now;
Every knee to Him shall bow:
Crown the Savior, angels, crown Him;
In the seat of pow'r enthrone Him,
While the vault of heaven rings:
Crown the Savior King of kings.
Crown the Savior King of kings.
Saints and angels crowd around Him,
Own His title, praise His Name:
O what joy the sight affords!
King of kings, and Lord of lords!
King of kings, and Lord of lords!
